prakriti.note: The pages extracted (Ch. XI-XIV of Chikitsa Sthana) primarily cover disease treatment. Prakriti-defining symptoms are inferred from dosa-specific disease manifestations described in the text. Full Prakriti chapters (Vimana Sthana) are not in this extract. Data below is derived strictly from dosa characterisation within the extracted pages.

physical: Black or reddish tinge in nails, eyes, face, skin
Prominent thin and black streaks and veins
digestive: Obstruction in flatus, stool and urine
disease_tendency: Vataja swelling (unstable, reddish/black, aggravated during day)
Vatodara - tympanitis, upward movement of vayu, body-ache
aggravated_signs: Blackish tinge in nails, eyes, face

physical: Green and yellow tinge in nails, eyes, face, skin
Blue, yellow, green or coppery streaks and veins
digestive: Burning sensation in mouth and abdomen
disease_tendency: Pittaja swelling - soft, odorous, burning, suppuration

physical: Whiteness in nails, eyes, face, skin
disease_tendency: Kaphaja swelling - heavy, stable, pale, aggravated at night
aggravated_signs: Swelling in hands, feet, scrotum, thighs

vata_pitta: Kaksya (Herpes Zoster) - blisters arranged like sacred thread caused by both vata and pitta
Pidalika - severe swelling with burning, redness and intense pain around throat
pitta_kapha: Romantika (Measles) - small eruptions all over body with fever, burning, thirst, itching, salivation
Masirika (Chickenpox) - lentil-sized eruptions caused by pitta and kapha
vata_kapha: Bradhna (Inguinal Hernia) - intestinal loop displacement with symptoms of both dosas
Shipada (Filariasis) - vitiation of mamsa, kapha and vata
